cases.title: A move meant to be constant speed is eased: one sentence on which end isn't linear; checked again

rubric.reason: Once the turn 3 check showed all Blink pairs held, the mentor asked "is there a move here that should run at constant speed, like a steady spin?"; in turn 4 the check returned not_linear, and the mentor named the pair (0.25 s to 4.25 s) and the end ("the key at 0.25 s eases out"), said how to set those keys to Linear, ended with "say 'done' and I'll check again", and changed nothing itself.

In turn 4 the mentor said what is still off and where (Blink's three pairs, 1 s to 2.2 s, are eased again; "Look at the keys at 1 s, 1.4 s and 1.8 s") without fixing or offering to; its Linear how-to is the instruction R-KT-LINEAR-CHECK calls for, not an offer to fix.

Every name and time the mentor used is in the tool results or the record, or follows directly from them: Blink and Cut Opacity at 1 s and 3 s, Dot 1 Position jumping at 0.5 s, Blink keys at 1/1.4/1.8/2.2 s, Seal as a precomp, Spinner › Rotation 0.25–4.25 s with the start side, and Title from the record.
